text: The Lattice Conductor moves Pulse around your camp. It makes none of its own. Place conductors within 8 of each other and a machine within 8 of any of them draws from the generators, Pulse Cairns and totem buffers that line can reach. One craft makes four, which is a line long enough to walk a workshop away from its generator. Chalk-linked Resonance Totems are the other job: the Conductor fills their buffers so a station beside a totem can spend that store too.

pages.title: Drawing the lattice
text: Totems are joined with **Ritual Chalk**. Right-click one totem, then another within **16 blocks**. "Lattice link sealed" means it worked. Clicking the same totem twice cancels the pending mark. A stick of chalk is good for ten links or marks.
Linked totems form a network. Each totem's buffer holds **250 Pulse**, and any machine within 8 blocks of a totem can spend what is in it.

Conductors extend the zone without that chalk. Set them within 8 of each other, the first within 8 of a generator. A machine within 8 of any conductor on the line draws the generators, Pulse Cairns and totem buffers the line reaches. A redstone signal on a conductor cuts that block out of the line. The four from one craft are enough to cross a camp.
A chalk line carries voices too: a station counts the voice of a totem that is chalk-linked to one near it, as long as that partner stands within 16 blocks of the station.

steps.caption: Two totems stand apart. Any voices will do.
Right-click the first totem with Ritual Chalk to mark it.
Then right-click the second, up to 16 blocks away: the lattice link is sealed.
Place the Conductor within 8 blocks of the totems, and a generator within 8 blocks of the Conductor.
Each second it fills the totem buffers, and a station beside the far totem can spend that Pulse.

pages.title: How it works
text: Every second the Conductor pulls up to **10 Pulse** from generators within 8 blocks and spreads it across the linked totems. Ranked conductors move more.
Right-click it for a **25-Pulse** burst and a status line.
The Conductor fills the linked totem buffers. Echo stations and caches move their own items with hoppers.
The [Ley Binding](world_rites) rite can join two distant totems for a while, and the Conductor routes along that thread as if they stood side by side.

pages.title: When it goes quiet
text: A lever or any redstone signal pauses totem filling and cuts that conductor out of the Pulse zone.

Clicking a conductor that has no chalk link reports the Pulse zone. The zone does not need totems. "No network" on the Codex reading means those totem buffers are not linked yet; a totem network still needs at least two.
"No Pulse" means there is nothing to move: bring a generator within 8 blocks of the Conductor and charge it.
"The lattice is full" is not a fault: every linked totem is already holding its 250 Pulse and there is nowhere to put more. The Conductor starts again the moment a station spends some.
Sneak-use this book on it for the network size, the last Pulse pushed, and what is missing.
The lattice carries Pulse, not goods. To move items over distance, use [relays](wireless_cargo).
